why: The heuristic's next rung with the lookahead in the panel, on the cheaper seat this pull request adds. Search 25 put five heuristics in the panel and learned them: on 200 unseen seeds it beat search-23 itself 0.943 and gained on stun-first and search-19, but fell from 0.599 to 0.043 against the lookahead with lookahead-20, which was only its check, and its own mirror reached the round cap in every match (journal, 2026-09-25). Every search that left the lookahead out of its panel gave it back, and run 22, with it in on every seed, ran past three hours. So the lookahead sits in the panel as lookahead:learning/weights/lookahead-20.json@50: the first 50 benchmark seeds, 100 matches, about a quarter of a heuristic's cost at full length. Its floor is read on those matches only, wider than the others, and the hold-out replays it on every seed. The rest of the panel is search 25's: greedy, search-21, stun-first, search-19 and pressure-floor, all under the start's floor, from search-23, on content 813bb91b (Momentum a free strike, ADR 0078). No check: the one agent a check would have been is now in the panel. The budget is 5 rounds of 8, seed 0: search 25 played 61 candidates against five heuristics in 2h02, and the seat adds about 70 seconds a candidate, so 41 leave the hold-out, which now replays the lookahead on 200 seeds, inside three hours. What would make it a rung: a set that beats search-23 on seeds it never saw against the lookahead and pressure-floor without falling below it against the rest.
